scope: Shared mobile form/layout review and isolated native Android component walkthrough using synthetic data. Review navigation buttons in screenshots belong to the temporary harness, not the shipped app.

findingsFixed.issue: Android edge-to-edge keyboard covered focused inputs despite adjustResize
findingsFixed.change: Measure keyboard overlap, reserve a 12-point gap, reveal the focused input, and restore height on dismissal

findingsFixed.issue: Auth forms combined native keyboard insets and KeyboardAvoidingView
findingsFixed.change: Use one shared FormScrollView with native iOS insets and measured Android overlap

findingsFixed.issue: Forms and detail sheets had inconsistent keyboard/tap handling
findingsFixed.change: Shared keyboard handling for auth, trip notes, rider cancellation, document upload, detail sheets and the dormant booking component

findingsFixed.issue: Input component blocked native focus/submit props; multiline input height was fixed
findingsFixed.change: Forward the native input ref and props, support sign-in keyboard navigation, disable MFA autocorrection, and use flexible multiline minimum height

findingsFixed.issue: Large-text appearance selector crowded three options into a row
findingsFixed.change: Stack radio options below 380 points or above 125% font scale

findingsFixed.issue: Trip ID squeezed into a one-character column next to status at large font size
findingsFixed.change: Stack trip header and addresses at narrow widths/large font sizes; keep full addresses available in this layout

findingsFixed.issue: Rows, metrics and modal actions could exceed narrow screens
findingsFixed.change: Allow pagination, route stops, driver actions, metrics and sheet headers to wrap; make document type chooser scrollable

findingsFixed.issue: Navigation labels and icon affordances were inconsistent
findingsFixed.change: Add driver Payments header; use an account icon for account navigation; use Trip summary for finished-trip headings and Back to trips for driver navigation

notVerified: TalkBack/VoiceOver spoken navigation on physical devices
cleanup: Only the temporary review application/emulator and its server are removed. Existing emulators, app sessions and production services are preserved.
